prompt: Write the note left under a windshield wiper after backing into a truck in the church parking lot. It must fully accept responsibility, contain a working phone number format, quote Scripture appropriately, and still somehow preserve your dignity. Four constraints. All of them.
response:
To the Owner of the Truck I Struck,

I am writing to take full and sole responsibility for backing into your vehicle in this parking lot earlier today. I was not paying adequate attention to my surroundings, and there is no excuse for my carelessness; the fault is entirely mine. As Proverbs 28:13 reminds us, “Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy,” and I believe that principle applies as much to fenders as it does to faith.

I have already contacted my insurance provider to open a claim and will ensure your vehicle is restored to its prior condition at no cost to you. Please call or text me at (555) 234-5678 at your earliest convenience so we can coordinate the repair process directly. I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and damage, and I am committed to making this right with both integrity and promptness.

Respectfully,  
Jordan Ellis
